SELECT
  id,
  email,
  "personName",
  "vehicleRegistration",
  "notificationType",
  "notificationChannel",
  status,
  "confirmationAttempts",
  aggressive_days_sent,
  CASE
    WHEN is_aggressive_mode = true AND "lastReminderSent"::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Aggressive_mode'
    WHEN "lastReminderSent"::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Reminders_pdr'
    WHEN COALESCE("emailSentAt", "smsSentAt")::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Today_pdr'
  END AS flow,
  COALESCE("lastReminderSent", "emailSentAt", "smsSentAt") AS sent_at
FROM vehicle_notifications
WHERE "emailSentAt"::date = CURRENT_DATE
   OR "smsSentAt"::date = CURRENT_DATE
   OR "lastReminderSent"::date = CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY flow, email;
